question:
**Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:**

Rare minerals are known to have been secretly extracted from the site by unauthorized workers before the inspection.

options.text: Unauthorized workers extracted the rare minerals before inspection.
The site was secretly mined before the inspection.
Unauthorized workers are known to have secretly extracted rare minerals before inspection.
The minerals had been extracted prior to inspection.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• Active voice structure: The subject of the active voice sentence performs the action described.
 
• The sentence in the active voice is: "Unauthorized workers are known to have secretly extracted rare minerals before inspection."
